wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
MONEY COLLECTION FEATURE
 The MONEY symbol, at every spin takes a random value from a predefined set. The possible values are:
 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 7.5x, 10x, 20x and 50x total bet.
 Whenever at least one WILD symbol along with MONEY symbols hit, for every WILD the total
 value of money symbols on the screen is awarded.
 FREE SPINS
 Hit 6 or more MONEY symbols to trigger the free spins round.
 6 to 11 MONEY symbols awards 6 free spins.
 12 to 17 MONEY symbols awards 8 free spins.
 18 to 20 MONEY symbols awards 10 free spins.
 Before the round starts, the value of all MONEY symbols that triggered the round is added together and collected,
 serving as the starting value for the progressive feature.
 The FREE SPINS round has a progressive feature. During the round, the values of all MONEY symbols that hit are
 collected and every WILD symbol that hits during the round awards the currently collected value.
The number of MONEY symbols that hit during the round is collected in a meter. Every 6 MONEY symbols awards 2
 more free spins.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.
